venue.name: [Fort Langley Evangelical Free Church](https://www.flefc.org/)
venue.address: 8870 Glover Road, Fort Langley, BC, Canada V1M 2K1
venue.details: The competition will be located in the gym.

items.information:
Speedcubing has at last come to the township of Langley! We look forward to a full house of 90 competitive cubers on Saturday April 7th, 2018!

Canadian or USD cash is required at the competition for those wishing to eat on site at our handy concession.

Calling for additional help: Those previously experienced as scramblers, judges and runners willing to gift some of their time on April 7th are asked to e-mail [Lindy](mailto:lindy@flefc.org) to commit to volunteering for a portion of the day!

**A second registration period will open on Saturday, March 3rd, at 10 AM (Pacific Time).**

items.name: No Place For DNF Spring 2018
items.information:
**Competitor Limit: 100
Registration Fee: $25.00**

**-All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate charity.
-Cube Depot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor.
-We will be holding a raffle. Bring one working cube per contestant in exchange for a raffle ticket. Cubes collected will be donated to spread cubing awareness. Additional raffle tickets may be purchased for $1 each.
-FMC will begin promptly at 8:45. If you arrive after 8:45 and want to participate, you are welcome to compete, but will have to finish at 9:45.
-Please observe silence during FMC.**

items.name: Berkeley Spring 2018

venue.name: UC Berkeley
venue.details: SATURDAY WILL BE HELD IN 2060 VALLEY LIFE SCIENCES BUILDING. SUNDAY WILL BE HELD IN 145 DWINELLE.

items.information:
This is the springtime competition at UC Berkeley, run by the Berkeley Cube Club!

**Travel:** Parking is hard to find at and around UC Berkeley. Plan to arrive early if driving so that you have time to find a spot -- you might need to park some distance away and walk. Buses and BART are a good alternative (the Downtown Berkeley BART station is near the west end of campus).

**Please be at least 15 minutes early to your first event of each day.**
